description: Deutsche Bahn (or DB) serves Bamberg with a dependable train service. Frequent trains run from/to [[Nuremberg]] (twice an hour by regional express; 40 min), [[Wurzburg]] (twice an hour; 55–70 min), and [[Bayreuth]] (once every two hours; 70 min). ICE high-speed trains from [[Munich]] (1 hr 45 min), [[Berlin]] (2 hr 45 min) call here at least every second hour, also linking Bamberg with Erfurt (45 min) and Leipzig (1 hr 30 min). Several times a day, there is even a direct train from [[Hamburg]] (4 hr 40 min). From Frankfurt, there is a relatively slow regional express connection every other hour (taking 3 hr) or you may take the ICE and change trains in Würzburg (2 hr 10 min–2 hr 30 min). See [http://www.bahn.de Deutsche Bahn's website] for more information.

Is held over the last weekend in August, Sandkerwa is a six day folk festival that consumes the entire town, with some 300,000 people attending. It is a festival with offerings of beer and food that rivals or even exceeds the likes of Oktoberfest and includes local traditions such as "fish jousting".
